verdict.rationale: Algolia publishes rich human-readable API docs and an llms.txt/doc.md index for LLM consumption, but a direct probe for a machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec at standard paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404 on all candidates, and no evidence pack item points to a downloadable OpenAPI file elsewhere. llms.txt/doc.md are documentation indexes, not a formal API spec (no endpoint/schema definitions), so they don't satisfy the story.
